title: When searching starts keeping you unsettled
issueStatement: You keep reaching for a new explanation, practice, or environment, but the heart is still not learning how to stay and receive.
centralInsight: Gurbani honors sincere seeking, but it does not leave the seeker wandering forever. Search has to ripen into instruction, company, and lived return.
practicalReflection: The danger is not desire for truth. The danger is making motion itself feel spiritual while the mind keeps avoiding surrender.
actionPrompt: For one day, stop adding new spiritual input and stay faithfully with one guide, one shabad, and one act of sangat.
